items.headline: Nelly Korda's US Women’s Open Win
items.text: Nelly Korda won the US Women’s Open at Riviera, making a historic LPGA Tour first for an American after changing her game mid-tournament.

items.headline: Jon Rahm's OWGR Jump
items.text: Jon Rahm returned to the top 10 in the Official World Golf Rankings following his performance at LIV Golf Andalucia.
